body:
### Working with Your Morgan Stanley Financial Advisor

During times of volatility, remind yourself of the reasons you invested in the first place and the long-term goals you are working toward. It's crucial to stay grounded in the knowledge that markets have historically recovered over time and that a disciplined mindset — and the support and guidance of your Financial Advisor — can help you navigate these fluctuations with confidence.
